title: khash caches keys and ed_flags across a Ruby hash or eql? callback that rehashes and frees h->data
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 84cc5aa60 (84cc5aa60130a575c93bdae56e84d8298f71f997) (2026-07-26), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: heap-use-after-free (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: heap-use-after-free); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
